correctness.rationale: The claim is mathematically correct for the stated real or complex ell_p^3 smooth range 1<p<infinity. The unique normalized duality map gives the quotient (A u^(p-1)+B v)/(1+u^p+v^p), with interior global maximizer for A,B>0 by epsilon perturbation on boundary and compactness. Stationarity yields p w u=(p-1)A, p w v^(p-1)=B and u^p/(p-1)+(p-1)v^p=1, hence a unique strictly decreasing positive scalar root and the exact mixed-Luxemburg norm. Zero-weight cases are rank-one limits; p=2 gives sqrt(A^2+B^2)/2. Continuous image of connected sphere plus phase rotations supplies full disk over C and interval over R. For p=4 the stated identity H^3-(CH+D^3)^2=CD(C^4+3C^3D+3C^2D^2+3CD^3+D^4)>0 and uniqueness of positive cubic roots rigorously imply v_4(A,B)>v_4(B,A) for all A>B>0. Independent symbolic polynomial expansion verified the quartic factorization; 56 parameter cases with KKT witness and independent optimization gave max numerical violation 0, duality and witness discrepancies below 9e-16. Numerical cases do not establish universal proof; that follows from the analytic chain in RESULT.md.
residual_risks: No p=1 or p=infinity assertion is proved; no longer-shift or general matrix extension.
Finite numeric optimization and exact symbolic factorization support but do not replace analytic global proof; no Lean/expert certificate is claimed.

originality.rationale: FAIL by decisive exact published mathematical coverage. The published Resultary 2026/10/11 b6805f9f0272 result states and proves exactly the same h_p times the mixed (p,q) gauge as the assigned result for complex arbitrary weights, with full disk and duality. The published b3244292cab1 result independently gives an equivalent universal scalar-root radius on real/complex ell_p^3 with positive weights and maximizing phases. These match objects, parameters, normalization and statements, not just title/keywords. The quartic all-weight order statement is a consequence of comparing the prior universally exact radius functions, and thus cannot rescue an otherwise covered theorem. Both published source texts were actually read; older journal work is only narrower background. Date-order uncertainty between same-day published records is preserved as a historical risk, not used to assert independence or originality.
residual_risks: The two exact-covering Resultary findings and audited record carry the same stated publication date 2026-10-11, so their intra-day chronology or independent authorship is not determined here; as of this 2026-10-25 audit, however, the complete target statement is already published twice, preventing distinct originality under the requested implication standard.
Older literature beyond the inspected primary sources may provide additional, earlier coverage; finding more coverage would not alter the originality failure.
A published exact formula may be expressed through alternative monotone stationary variables; the mathematical equivalence has been explicitly compared, not inferred from titles.
